# v1.3.9 — Android bottom tab bar measures the real system nav inset

- Fix: the bottom tab bar no longer reserves a fabricated 24px gap on Android.
  It now measures the real system navigation inset — `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`
  plus the inset Capacitor injects on Android 15+ — and only reserves bottom
  distance when the system's home/back/recents buttons are actually present.
- On gesture-navigation phones the bar is 64px tall (was 88px); 3-button
  navigation keeps the full distance so its buttons are never covered.
- Keyboard-sized viewport gaps (larger than 48px) are ignored, so the bar is not
  pushed up by the on-screen keyboard.
- No other behaviour changed.
